Coram : P. SATHASIVAM*, RANJANA PRAKASH DESAI, RANJAN GOGOI
C Constitution of India, 1950 - Art. 136 - Special Leave Petition - Criminal proceedings - third party intervention - Maintainability - Held: Law does not recognize right of a third party/stranger to participate or came to aid proceeding - In the instant case, the petitioner (a third D party), is not seeking impleadment in the inquiry against the juvenile accused, pending before the Juvenile Justice Board or in the trial - He is seeking an authoritative pronouncement of the true purport and effect of different
Decision Date : 22-08-2013 | Case No : SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CRIMINAL) No. 1953/2013 | Direction Issue : Notice issued | Bench : 3 Judges
